title: P0: Reader Journey context/grounding integrity (prevent cross-book contamination)

commits.message: Guard Reader Journey against claim/evidence and context integrity failures (CHG-20260722-005).

user_summary: Reader Journey出现非当前小说内容且错误结论绑定当前段落证据，暂停污染Artifact展示并加强来源指纹与校验。
technical_summary: Graded Journey integrity: trusted/partially_trusted/legacy_unverified/data_integrity_failed; legacy without fingerprint shows with warning; soft claim heuristics only when fingerprint ok; severe wrong-book/context mismatch still blocks; field/scene redaction for partial.
acceptance_criteria: 污染Artifact不展示为可信结果
verification_evidence: Reader Journey出现非当前小说内容
错误结论绑定当前Paragraph ID
可能存在缓存、查询作用域、异步绑定或Provider上下文污染
Run #9暂停作为可信结果使用
Run #8真实跨上下文污染必须阻断
完整性校验上线后多个Journey被整体阻断
单节点/单字段失败不得阻断全部Journey
实体抽取把分析套话误判为跨书实体导致系统性误伤
